## Description

Consumables with batch, expiry and reorder level; an autoclave cycle log (cycle, date, operator, result) with instrument sets linked to the visits that used them.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Expired items are flagged and cannot be logged as used.
- [ ] **AC2.** A failed cycle lists the instrument sets and visits it affects.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
